answer: Sybil farms flood open grade seats. Mechanism: each identity must clear a 72-minute sequential work ledge, then dock on a rotating jetty of 6 peer relays; only the 3 lowest Hamming-distance dune digests H(work||epoch||relay) from relays aged ≥2 epochs count. Clone cost tracks GPU wall-clock. Peers reject reused relay slots or short ledge windows before the panel locks.
